crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and…
For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;
Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…
In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came…
In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
translations.bsb: “Son of man, write down today’s date, for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
translations.asv: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.
